first_restart: ssh.service only — failed; systemd socket still bound 0.0.0.0:22888
root_cause: ssh.socket + sshd-socket-generator ListenStream=0.0.0.0:22888 overrides sshd_config ListenAddress
fix: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart ssh.socket ssh
rollback: rm /etc/systemd/system/ssh.socket.d/99-arifOS-tailscale-only.conf /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-arifOS-tailscale-only.conf && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart ssh.socket ssh
